text:
jason_support: Alpha Health trial: embedding ingest failing with intermittent 503s since 09:12 PT. Customer can't finish setup. Marking P1 and passing to CS for immediate handoff. Key details below.
jason_support: Customer: Alpha Health (trial, 14d). Renewal in 9 days if they convert. Affected flow: batch ingest -> embeddings API -> error 503, retries succeed sometimes. Error sample: ```503 Service Unavailable
req_id=xcv-21
model=embedding-ock```
oncall_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-7456, priority=P1, owner=eng-oncall
maria_cs: Thanks Jason. Elaine, can you own outreach? We should offer a workaround and timeline. CC @sam_eng for root cause.
elaine_csm: On it. I'll reach out to the customer's CSM inbox in 10m. Proposed message: 'We're investigating; temporary workaround: split batch into 50 items or use rate_limit=10.' Thoughts?
sam_eng: I'll look at logs. Can you share the ingestion payload size + client region? Also paste the last request id if possible.
jason_support: Payloads are ~6-8MB per batch. Region: us-west-2. Last failing req_id: xcv-21 (same as above). We saw a spike in concurrent KV cache misses around the window.
sam_eng: Noted. Quick test: try reducing batch_size to 50 and add backoff. If that stabilizes, we can propose a short-term mitigation while infra patches routing.
elaine_csm: Draft outreach sent to Alpha Health. Message includes workaround + offer to schedule 30m debug call today. I'll link their admin contact.
jason_support: :thumbsup: Please ping if they accept. Also added escalation note to the account (renewal risk flag).
maria_cs: Assigning follow-ups: Elaine to contact customer; Sam to run deeper trace and propose fix; Jason to update support ticket and include timeline. ETA for triage update: 45min.
elaine_csm: Customer accepted the workaround and will try splitting batches now. Scheduling call at 14:30 PT. Adding internal notes.
sam_eng: Found a transient routing error on host gpu-22 in us-west-2. Rolling a fix to remove stale route. Will report back once redeploy completes (~20m).
jason_support: Thanks all. If redeploy doesn't resolve, we escalate to infra and consider temporary capacity switch to dedicated pool. Flagged renewal risk to AM.
elaine_csm: I'll draft comms for AM and propose a 1-week credit if the trial is impacted. Save for post-mortem. :memo:
oncall_bot: INC-2026-7456 status update: fix deployed to us-west-2; observed 5min stabilization. Monitoring.
sam_eng: Monitoring looks good. No more 503s in the last 10m on that route. Recommending follow-up 24h watch.
elaine_csm: Call completed, customer satisfied with workaround and timeline. They're OK with a credit. I'll update renewal playbook.
maria_cs: Great work. Closing handoff — Elaine will own customer comms and AM will handle credit. Add to weekly CS sync as case study.
